title: Suction Cleaner Stationary
shortDescription: Cleaner sits still on pool floor.
fullDescription: Kreepy Krauly suction cleaners do not display electronic codes; F1 is shorthand for the most common complaint of no movement. Likely causes include closed valve, clogged hose, or broken diaphragm.

fixSteps.title: Verify valve
fixSteps.instruction: Open suction valve to dedicated line.

title: Cleaner Hangs in One Area
shortDescription: Cleaner pulses but does not roam.
fullDescription: F2 captures cleaners that pulse but do not move around the pool. Hose length, fittings, and flow setting are the common culprits.

fixSteps.title: Untangle
fixSteps.instruction: Lay hose straight in sun for 30 min.

title: Cleaner Stays at Surface
shortDescription: Cleaner won't sink to pool floor.
fullDescription: F3 describes cleaners that float and do not return to the floor, indicating air in the hose or a leak.

fixSteps.title: Bleed air
fixSteps.instruction: Submerge hose to fill with water.

faq.a: Pump lid o-ring is common leak.

title: Excessive Clicking
fullDescription: F4 references diaphragm clicking out of normal range (60-90 cycles/min). Indicates wear or flow issue.

title: Wheel Bearings Worn
fullDescription: F5 - on Kruiser models with wheels, refers to seized wheel bearings.

title: Cleaner Climbs Out of Water
fullDescription: F6 describes cleaner climbing too high and surfacing. Adjust flow valve to reduce suction.

faq.a: Suction cleaner not designed for steep walls.

title: Hose Coiled/Stiff
fullDescription: F7 means hose retains box shape, restricting movement.

title: Foot Pad Worn Out
fullDescription: F8 indicates worn foot pad reducing scrubbing/grip. Replace with service kit.

fixSteps.title: Replace pad
fixSteps.instruction: Slide off old pad, fit new.

title: Skimmer Pulling Cleaner
fullDescription: F9 describes cleaner getting pulled into skimmer when connected to skimmer line. Adjust valving or use dedicated suction line.

title: Cleaner Wing/Skirt Damaged
fullDescription: F10 indicates the suction skirt/wing is damaged, reducing seal and movement. Replace.
